en.desc: Ar-Rahman is the One whose mercy is boundless and encompasses all of creation, believers and non-believers alike. His compassion flows to every living thing without measure.
en.dua: Call upon Ar-Rahman when seeking Allah's mercy and compassion — in moments of hardship, grief, or when asking forgiveness for yourself and others.

fr.desc: Cl\u00E9ment envers ses cr\u00E9atures. La cl\u00E9mence d'une m\u00E8re envers son enfant est une partie infime de Son immense cl\u00E9mence envers Ses cr\u00E9atures. Son ch\u00E2timent est le plus dur et s\u00E9v\u00E8re de tous les ch\u00E2timents mais Sa cl\u00E9mence a pr\u00E9c\u00E9d\u00E9 Sa col\u00E8re ; et ce nom fait partie des noms que l\u2019on n\u2019attribue \u00E0 nul autre qu'Allah.

en.desc: Ar-Raheem is the One whose special, enduring mercy is reserved for the believers, guiding and rewarding them in this life and the next. His mercy is a continuous grace upon those who turn to Him.
en.dua: Call upon Ar-Raheem when hoping for Allah's lasting mercy and reward — when striving in obedience, seeking guidance, or asking to be among the faithful He cares for.

fr.desc: Mis\u00E9ricordieux pour ce qu'Il a cr\u00E9\u00E9. Il fait pleuvoir le ciel au-dessus des peuples m\u00EAme les plus p\u00E9cheurs par mis\u00E9ricorde envers les b\u00E9b\u00E9s, les vieux et les animaux, alors qu'Il (a pu) peut (et pourra) les ch\u00E2tier par soif. Le terme Ar-Rahm\u0101n englobe la signification du terme Ar-Rah\u012Bm sans retirer sa signification initiale

en.desc: Al-Malik is the absolute King and Owner of all that exists, whose dominion and authority are complete and everlasting. Everything in the heavens and the earth belongs to Him and is subject to His command.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Malik when you feel powerless or in need of authority over your affairs — when seeking dignity, leadership, or trust that everything is ultimately in His control.

fr.desc: Est Celui \u00E0 qui ce monde appartient en r\u00E9alit\u00E9 et en totalit\u00E9 et Celui dont la domination est absolue et exempte de toute imperfection alors que la domination chez les cr\u00E9atures est cr\u00E9\u00E9e par Al-Malik

en.desc: Al-Quddus is the One who is utterly pure and free from every flaw, imperfection, and deficiency. He is transcendent above anything unworthy of His majesty.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Quddus when seeking purification of your heart and soul — when repenting from sin, cleansing yourself of bad character, or striving for sincerity in worship.

fr.desc: Le Sanctifi\u00E9

en.desc: As-Salam is the One who is perfectly free from all defects and the true source of peace, safety, and well-being. From Him alone comes tranquility of the heart.
en.dua: Call upon As-Salam when your heart is anxious or troubled — when seeking inner peace, safety from harm, or reconciliation and calm in times of conflict.

fr.desc: Celui qui procure la paix, le calme et la s\u00E9r\u00E9nit\u00E9. En citant ce nom, on d\u00E9clare la paix pour soi-m\u00EAme et pour ceux qui nous entourent.

en.desc: Al-Mu'min is the One who grants faith and security, and who confirms the truth of His promises. He removes fear and gives His servants safety and assurance.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Mu'min when you are afraid or feel unsafe — when seeking protection, steadfastness in faith, or reassurance that Allah's promises will not fail you.

fr.desc: Ce nom est myst\u00E9rieux m\u00EAme pour les Musulmans car \" Al-Mu'min \" vient du nom \" Al-imane \" qui veut dire croire, d'o\u00F9 vient le nom \" Al-Mu'minoune \" qui veut dire les croyants, c'est l'appellation du Coran pour les gens qui croient en 6 choses : l'unicit\u00E9 de Dieu, l'existence des anges, des livres saints (Torah, \u00C9vangile et Psaumes (Zabor) non modifi\u00E9s et le Coran), les proph\u00E8tes, le jour dernier (le jour du jugement) et le destin son mal et son bien. La signification exacte de ce nom est tr\u00E8s difficile \u00E0 cerner dans son sens premier mais peut se comprendre d'un point de vue plus profond et mystique

en.desc: Al-Muhaymin is the ever-watchful Guardian who oversees, preserves, and protects all of His creation. Nothing escapes His witness, and He safeguards His servants from harm.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Muhaymin when you need Allah's protection and watchful care — over your loved ones, your affairs, or when you feel vulnerable and unseen by others.

fr.desc: Celui qui domine Sa cr\u00E9ation et par Son omnig\u00E9rance sous tous les aspects, aucun \u00E9tat ni aucun aspect dans ce monde ou dans l'autre n'\u00E9chappe \u00E0 Sa volont\u00E9

en.desc: Al-Azeez is the All-Mighty, invincible in power and honor, whom nothing can overcome. He is exalted above all and grants might to whom He wills.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Azeez when you feel weak or defeated — when seeking strength against difficulty, victory over hardship, or honor and dignity in the face of humiliation.

fr.desc: Le Glorieux par Sa supr\u00E9matie et par Sa grandeur, El-Aziz veut dire dans un sens celui qui est cher et pr\u00E9cieux aux yeux de Ses cr\u00E9atures. Il n'est le serviteur d'aucune cr\u00E9ature, et aucune cr\u00E9ature ne lui dicte ce qu'Il doit faire.

en.desc: Al-Jabbar is the One whose will prevails over all, compelling His creation as He wills while nothing can compel Him. He is also the One who mends what is broken and restores those who are wounded.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Jabbar when you feel broken or crushed by circumstances — when your heart needs mending, or when you seek Allah to set right what has fallen apart in your life.

fr.desc: Le grandiose, l'ultime puissant par Sa grandeur et Sa force illimit\u00E9e. Lorsqu'Il d\u00E9truit les oppresseurs (injustes et p\u00E9cheurs) Il applique Sa sentence avec Justice.

en.desc: Al-Mutakabbir is the One rightfully possessed of all greatness and majesty, transcendent above every flaw and above resembling His creation. True pride belongs to Him alone.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Mutakabbir when you seek to overcome arrogance in yourself or others — when humbling your heart before Allah, or seeking His aid against the pride of oppressors.

fr.desc: Celui qui est sup\u00E9rieur \u00E0 Ses cr\u00E9atures, nulle cr\u00E9ature n'a le droit de pr\u00E9tendre \u00E0 la grandeur.

en.desc: Al-Khaliq is the Creator of all things, who brings everything into existence from nothing according to His perfect design. He originates and determines the measure of all that is.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Khaliq when you marvel at creation or seek something new in your life — when hoping for a fresh beginning, a child, or a solution He alone can bring into being.

fr.desc: Le Cr\u00E9ateur de toutes existences, vivantes ou bien mortes, mobiles ou fig\u00E9es.

en.desc: Al-Baari is the Maker who brings creation into being flawlessly, free of imbalance or contradiction. He fashions all things in perfect harmony and proportion.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Baari when seeking balance and harmony — in your health, your relationships, or when asking Allah to put your affairs in right and orderly form.

fr.desc: Celui qui l\u00e8ve Sa cr\u00e9ation au-dessus de tous d\u00e9fauts ou imperfections.

en.desc: Al-Musawwir is the One who shapes and fashions each created thing with its own distinct form and features. Every shape and appearance in existence is the work of His design.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Musawwir when you struggle with self-image or long for beauty and goodness — when seeking contentment with how you were made, or asking Allah to shape your character.

fr.desc: Celui qui donne l'aspect et l'apparence \u00e0 chaque cr\u00e9ation de l'int\u00e9rieur ainsi que de l'ext\u00e9rieur. Dans l'arabe perdu, de fa\u00e7on litt\u00e9rale, ce mot veut dire le sculpteur et, dans l'arabe moderne, veut dire litt\u00e9ralement le dessinateur.

en.desc: Al-Ghaffar is the One who forgives again and again, veiling the sins of His servants and pardoning them repeatedly. His forgiveness is vast for all who turn back to Him in repentance.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Ghaffar when burdened by sin and seeking repentance — especially when you have erred repeatedly and long for Allah to conceal your faults and pardon you.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui pardonne ce qu'Il veut \u00e0 qui Il veut.

en.desc: Al-Qahhar is the Subduer whose irresistible power dominates all of creation, and to whom everything ultimately submits. None can escape or overcome His will.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Qahhar when facing overwhelming oppression or your own lower desires — when seeking Allah to subdue what harms you and to help you master temptation and injustice.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui est tout puissant \u00e0 soumettre toute cr\u00e9ation \u00e0 Sa volont\u00e9.

en.desc: Al-Wahhab is the One who gives continuously and freely, without being asked and without expecting return. His gifts are endless and flow purely out of His generosity.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Wahhab when in need of blessings you cannot earn — when asking for gifts of the heart such as knowledge, righteous children, or provision you did not expect.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui donne immens\u00E9ment sans rien recevoir en retour

en.desc: Ar-Razzaq is the sole Provider who sustains every creature with all that it needs to live. He grants provision to whom He wills, in body, mind, and soul.
en.dua: Call upon Ar-Razzaq when worried about sustenance — when seeking lawful income, relief from financial hardship, or trust that your provision is already written and secure.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui fait distribuer \u00e0 toute cr\u00e9ature ce dont elle a besoin.

en.desc: Al-Fattah is the Opener who unlocks what is closed, granting relief, victory, and clarity. He opens the gates of mercy, sustenance, and understanding for His servants.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Fattah when doors seem closed before you — when seeking a way out of difficulty, guidance in confusion, or the opening of new opportunities and success.

fr.desc: Est Celui Qui seul connait les cl\u00e9s du futur et l'inconnu, de par Sa connaissance et de par Sa sagesse. Ce nom est souvent associ\u00e9 au nom suivant \"Al-\u2018Al\u012bm\".

en.desc: Al-'Aleem is the One whose knowledge is complete and perfect, encompassing all things seen and unseen, past, present, and future. Nothing is hidden from Him.
en.dua: Call upon Al-'Aleem when seeking knowledge, guidance, or clarity in a decision — and when you feel misunderstood, knowing that He alone fully understands your heart.

fr.desc: Celui \u00e0 qui rien ne peut se cacher, car Il connait tout et est conscient de tout.

en.desc: Al-Qabid is the One who constricts and withholds provision, life, and blessings according to His perfect wisdom. What He restrains is by His justice and knowledge alone.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Qabid when facing loss or scarcity — when seeking patience through hardship, protection from harm, and trust that what is withheld carries hidden wisdom.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui restreint Son bien conform\u00e9ment \u00e0 une sagesse.

en.desc: Al-Basit is the One who expands and extends provision, mercy, and ease to His servants as He wills. He opens hearts and enlarges sustenance according to His generosity.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Basit when hoping for relief and abundance — when seeking expansion in your provision, openness of heart, or the lifting of tightness and distress.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui lib\u00e8re, augmente et multiplie son bien conform\u00e9ment \u00e0 une sagesse.

en.desc: Al-Khafid is the One who lowers and brings down the arrogant, the tyrannical, and those who defy the truth. He humbles whom He wills by His perfect justice.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Khafid when wronged by the proud or the oppressive — when seeking justice against tyranny, and asking Allah to keep your own heart humble.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui destine les oppresseurs et les orgueilleux au rabaissement et au ch\u00e2timent.

en.desc: Ar-Rafi' is the One who raises and elevates in rank, honor, and nearness to Him whomever He wills. He lifts the humble and the sincere to lofty stations.
en.dua: Call upon Ar-Rafi' when seeking to be raised in status or spirit — when hoping for success, elevation in faith, or to be lifted out of lowliness and hardship.

fr.desc: L'\u00c9leveur dans le sens d'\u00e9lever, celui qui \u00e9l\u00e8ve l'honneur, le statut et le prestige d'un \u00eatre dans ce bas monde et dans l'au-del\u00e0.

en.desc: Al-Mu'izz is the One who bestows honor, strength, and dignity upon whomever He wills. All true honor comes from Him alone and cannot be granted by any other.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Mu'izz when you feel belittled or long for dignity — when seeking honor and respect through obedience to Allah rather than the fleeting approval of people.

fr.desc: Celui qui offre l'honneur et la valeur pr\u00e9cieuse.

en.desc: Al-Mudhill is the One who abases and disgraces the arrogant and the defiant according to His wisdom and justice. He withdraws honor from whom He wills.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Mudhill when seeking protection from disgrace — when asking Allah to guard you from a humiliating end, and to bring low the harm of those who oppress unjustly.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui peut humilier et d\u00e9valoriser n'importe quel valeureux.

en.desc: Allah is the One who hears all things, both the spoken word and the unspoken thought. No sound is too faint and no plea too silent to escape His perfect hearing.
en.dua: Call upon As-Samee' when you feel unheard — pour out your private prayers knowing Allah hears every whisper and silent plea.

fr.desc: Celui qui entend tout bruit ou son dans Son royaume \u00e9manant de n'importe quelle cr\u00e9ature et aussi Celui qui \u00e9coute les invocations de Ses cr\u00e9atures pour r\u00e9pondre \u00e0 leurs invocations.

en.desc: Allah is the One whose sight encompasses all things, seeing what is hidden as clearly as what is open. Nothing in the heavens or the earth is concealed from His vision.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Baseer when your efforts go unnoticed by others — take comfort that Allah sees every good deed and hidden struggle, and rewards accordingly.

fr.desc: Est Celui \u00e0 qui rien de ce qui existe ou entre en existence ne peut \u00e9chapper, sans le moindre usage d\u2019\u0153il, d\u2019instrument ou d\u2019organe.

en.desc: Allah is the ultimate Judge whose rulings are absolutely just and never overturned. He settles every dispute with perfect fairness and gives each soul exactly its due.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Hakam when you have been wronged or treated unjustly — entrust your case to the Judge who never errs and will restore what is right.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui juge et d\u00e9partage les cr\u00e9atures ici-bas et dans l\u2019au-del\u00e0 et Celui qui assure l\u2019\u00e9quit\u00e9 entre les cr\u00e9atures et nul autre ne va et ne pourra les d\u00e9partager et les juger ; et le Jugement dans l\u2019au-del\u00e0 sera parfaitement juste et appropri\u00e9.

en.desc: Allah is the embodiment of perfect justice, free from any trace of oppression or bias. Every decree He issues is balanced and fair to all of His creation.
en.dua: Call upon Al-'Adl when you long for fairness in an unjust world — ask Him to grant you your rights and to help you act justly toward others.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui est exempt de toute forme d\u2019injustice et\/ou d\u2019oppression.

en.desc: Allah is gentle and gracious in ways beyond our perception, arranging affairs with a subtlety that only He fully knows. His kindness reaches His servants through paths they never expected.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Lateef when your problem feels tangled and beyond solving — trust that His gentle, unseen care can open a way you cannot yet imagine.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui accorde \u00e0 ses cr\u00e9atures Sa douceur et Sa bienveillance.

en.desc: Allah is fully acquainted with the innermost reality of all things, aware of every detail whether apparent or hidden. Nothing about His creation is unknown to Him.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Khabeer when you face a decision whose outcome you cannot foresee — seek guidance from the One who knows the true nature of every matter.

fr.desc: Est Celui \u00e0 qui ne peut \u00eatre cach\u00e9e la r\u00e9alit\u00e9 de chaque chose qui existe, c'est-\u00e0-dire la v\u00e9rit\u00e9 des choses ; aucun d\u00e9tail ne Lui \u00e9chappe ni la chose dans son ensemble, ni chacune de ses parties ; et pr\u00e9tendre pouvoir cacher des choses \u00e0 Celui qui cr\u00e9e toute chose est un \u00e9garement et une m\u00e9cr\u00e9ance.

en.desc: Allah is the Most Forbearing, who does not hasten to punish those who disobey Him but grants them respite and opportunity to repent. His patience with His servants is boundless.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Haleem when you have sinned and fear the consequences — turn back to Him gratefully, knowing He is patient and slow to punish those who repent.

fr.desc: Est Celui dont la patience envers les m\u00e9cr\u00e9ances des p\u00e9cheurs d\u00e9passe toute imagination (il est possible que le pardon leur soit accord\u00e9).

en.desc: Allah is the Magnificent, whose greatness and majesty are beyond any measure or comprehension. All might, glory, and grandeur belong to Him alone.
en.dua: Call upon Al-'Azeem when your troubles feel overwhelming — remember that no hardship is too great for the One whose magnificence surpasses all things.

fr.desc: Ce nom est difficile \u00e0 traduire car il inclut plusieurs mots fran\u00e7ais ne partageant pas le m\u00eame sens spirituel, mais on peut l'approcher comme suit : \" Al-Adh\u012bm \" Celui qui est Gigantesquement Majestueux et Fantastiquement Grandiose loin de toute imperfection corporelle ou mat\u00e9rielle

en.desc: Allah is the One who forgives sins abundantly and repeatedly, no matter how many times His servant falls and returns. His forgiveness is vast enough to cover every fault.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Ghafoor when the weight of your sins burdens you — seek His pardon sincerely, for He forgives again and again those who turn to Him.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui pardonne immens\u00e9ment maintes et maintes fois.

en.desc: Allah is the Most Appreciative, who rewards even the smallest act of obedience with generous and multiplied recompense. He never lets a good deed go unnoticed or unrewarded.
en.dua: Call upon Ash-Shakoor when your small acts of worship feel insignificant — offer them sincerely, knowing He magnifies little deeds into great rewards.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui montre Sa gratitude envers les adorations aussi incroyablement faciles soient-elles \u00e0 r\u00e9aliser.

en.desc: Allah is the Most High, exalted far above His creation in station, power, and perfection. He is transcendent above every limitation and shortcoming.
en.dua: Call upon Al-'Aliyy when you feel low or brought down by life — ask the Most High to raise your rank and lift you above your difficulties.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui est au-dessus de tous ce qu'Il a cr\u00e9\u00e9 parfaitement et inimaginablement.

en.desc: Allah is the Most Great, whose greatness surpasses everything in existence. Nothing rivals Him in status, majesty, or authority.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Kabeer when a challenge looms large before you — remind yourself that Allah is greater than anything you fear, and place your reliance in Him.

fr.desc: Le Grand : Celui qui est plus grand que Sa cr\u00e9ation, une grandeur que Lui seul conna\u00eet.

en.desc: Allah is the Preserver and Protector, who guards all that exists and keeps a perfect record of every deed. He safeguards whomever and whatever He wills from harm.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Hafeez when you fear for your safety, your family, or your faith — seek His protection to guard what is precious to you from every harm.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui prot\u00e8ge et pr\u00e9serve Son bien.

en.desc: Allah is the Sustainer, who provides nourishment and strength to all His creation and maintains everything that exists. He gives every being exactly what it needs to endure.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Muqeet when you worry about provision or feel unable to carry on — ask the Sustainer for the strength and nourishment to see you through.

fr.meaning: Est Celui qui ne laisse aucun détail lorsqu'Il juge, même les plus futiles.
fr.desc: Ce mot est parmi les mots perdus de la langue arabe ancienne; tr\u00e8s difficile \u00e0 traduire m\u00eame en arabe moderne}. Il signifierait : Est Celui qui ne laisse aucun d\u00e9tail lorsqu'Il juge, m\u00eame les plus futiles.

en.desc: Allah is the Reckoner, who takes account of every deed and will bring all actions to reckoning on the Day of Judgment. Nothing, however small, escapes His accounting.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Haseeb when you feel your good is overlooked or injustice goes unanswered — rest assured that He accounts for every deed with perfect precision.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui va compter tous les faits de Ses cr\u00e9atures sans oubli ni erreur.

en.desc: Allah is the Majestic, possessing supreme grandeur, power, and glory. His majesty inspires awe and reverence in the hearts of all who reflect upon Him.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Jaleel when your heart grows heedless or arrogant — reflect on His majesty to restore humility and reverence within yourself.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui est parfaitement exempt d'\u00eatre compar\u00e9 \u00e0 Ses cr\u00e9atures ou d'\u00eatre comme Lui.

en.desc: Allah is the Most Generous, whose giving knows no limit and who bestows favors without being asked. He honors His servants and continues to grant even when they fall short.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Kareem when you are in need and feel undeserving — ask freely of the Most Generous, whose bounty flows regardless of your shortcomings.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui de Sa g\u00e9n\u00e9rosit\u00e9 a inond\u00e9 Sa cr\u00e9ation.

en.desc: Allah is the Watchful, ever-observant over all His creation, from whom nothing is absent or hidden. He watches over every soul with complete and constant attention.
en.dua: Call upon Ar-Raqeeb when you struggle to stay upright when no one is watching — remember He observes all, and let that awareness guard your character.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui observe et regarde tout ce qu'Il a cr\u00e9\u00e9 (et les actions des cr\u00e9atures sont aussi des cr\u00e9ations).

en.desc: Allah is the Responsive, who is near to His servants and answers the supplications of those who call upon Him. He responds to every sincere need, invitation, and prayer.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Mujeeb when you are desperate for an answer to your prayers — ask with certainty, for He is near and responds to the one who calls sincerely.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui exauce les invocations de Ses cr\u00e9atures s'Il le veut et \u00e0 qui Il veut.

en.desc: Allah is the All-Encompassing, boundless in His knowledge, mercy, and provision. His bounty is vast enough to embrace all of creation without diminishing.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Waasi' when your provision or opportunities feel narrow and constrained — ask the All-Encompassing to widen your sustenance and ease from His limitless bounty.

fr.desc: Ce nom en arabe veut dire : immens\u00e9ment large, mais pour qualifier Dieu on comprend inclusivement qu'Il a rempli tout vide et a contenu toutes choses d'une fa\u00e7on que Lui seul conna\u00eet

en.desc: Allah is the All-Wise, whose every decree and action is founded upon perfect wisdom. He places all things in their rightful order and does nothing without purpose.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Hakeem when a hardship makes no sense to you — trust that His wisdom governs every event, even when the reason is hidden from you.

fr.desc: Celui de qui la Sagesse a \u00e9bloui, \u00e9blouit et \u00e9blouira n'importe quel esprit conscient et intelligent.

en.desc: Allah is the Most Loving, who loves His righteous servants and makes Himself beloved to them. His love is pure, constant, and freely given to those who turn toward Him.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Wudood when you feel lonely or unloved — draw close to Him in worship and ask Him to fill your heart with His love and to make you beloved to Him.

fr.desc: Ce mot en arabe veut dire : Celui qui se rapproche de son aim\u00E9 par la cl\u00E9mence, la piti\u00E9 et le bienfait, mais lorsqu'on lit ce nom dans le \" Coran \", on sent chaque fois diff\u00E9rents sens difficilement traduisibles en mots}. On peut tenter de le traduire : Celui qui se rapproche de Ses serviteurs par piti\u00E9 bien qu'ils s'\u00E9loignent de Lui et ne Le glorifient pas.

en.desc: Allah is the Most Glorious, perfect in power, high in status, and abundant in generosity and kindness. His glory unites majesty with boundless nobility.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Majeed when you seek honor and blessing in your life — glorify Him and ask the Most Glorious to bless your affairs with dignity and goodness.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui est glorifié dans l'infiniment passé, le présent et dans l'éternel.

en.desc: Allah is the Resurrector, who will raise the dead back to life on the Day of Judgment. He revives what has passed away and awakens hearts to guidance.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Baa'ith when you grieve a loss or feel spiritually lifeless — ask the Resurrector to revive your heart and to reunite you in the life to come.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui ressuscite les morts et d\u00E9ploie la vie dans ce qu'Il veut, soient-ils des hommes des animaux ou bien une terre tout simplement.

en.desc: Allah is the Witness, present over all things and fully aware of everything that occurs. He witnesses every action openly and inwardly, and His testimony is absolute.
en.dua: Call upon Ash-Shaheed when your truth is doubted or you are falsely accused — take solace that Allah witnessed the reality and His testimony needs no proof.

fr.desc: Le T\u00E9moin : Allah est l'ultime et parfait t\u00E9moin de tout ce qui s'est pass\u00E9 dans Son royaume, avec des preuves claires et flagrantes, parfaitement irr\u00E9prochables.

en.desc: He is the ultimate Truth and Reality, whose existence and every word are absolutely true. Everything besides Him is fleeting, but He and His truth remain.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Haqq when you feel lost in confusion or surrounded by falsehood — ask Him to anchor your heart in truth, grant you clarity, and let what is real prevail.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui d\u00E9tient la V\u00E9rit\u00E9 absolue.

en.meaning: The Trustee and Disposer of Affairs
en.desc: He is the perfect Guardian to whom all matters can be entrusted, managing the affairs of His creation with complete wisdom and sufficiency.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Wakeel when facing matters beyond your control — entrust your affairs to Him and rely on Him as your perfect Guardian and Disposer of affairs.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui garantit la subsistance des cr\u00E9atures et Celui \u00E0 qui rien de chacun de leurs \u00E9tats ne peut \u00EAtre dissimul\u00E9

en.desc: He is the possessor of complete and inexhaustible strength, and no power in creation can ever overcome or diminish His.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Qawiyy when you feel weak or overpowered by a difficulty — ask Him to lend you strength from His limitless might to endure and overcome.

fr.desc: Le Puissant : Allah est le plus puissant, le plus fort, sa force n'a pas de limite et ne se d\u00E9crit pas avec des d\u00E9finitions de la force physique.

en.desc: He is firm and unshakable in His strength, whose power never tires and whose will is never weakened.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Mateen when you need steadfastness and resolve — ask Him to make your faith firm and your footing steady in times of trial.

fr.desc: L'Endurant : Une endurance digne de Lui, illimit\u00E9e, infatigable, et qui n'est entach\u00E9e d'aucune faiblesse, sans pause, sans interruption et qu'aucun facteur ne peut att\u00E9nuer.

en.desc: He is the loving Guardian and Ally of the believers, who protects them, guides their affairs, and draws them from darkness into light.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Waliyy when you feel alone or unsupported — ask Him to be your Protector and close Ally, guarding you and directing your affairs toward good.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui pr\u00E9serve les serviteurs croyants, ainsi les proph\u00E8tes et ceux qui les suivent sont ceux qui sont les \u00AB gens pr\u00E9serv\u00E9s \u00BB dans le sens o\u00F9 ils ont \u00E9t\u00E9 guid\u00E9s vers le remerciement obligatoire \u00E0 l\u2019\u00E9gard de Celui qui les fait exister, c\u2019est-\u00E0-dire \u00E0 l\u2019\u00E9gard d'Allah

en.desc: He is worthy of all praise, for every perfection, blessing, and good deed ultimately traces back to Him.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Hameed when your heart overflows with gratitude or when you seek to praise Him rightly — thank Him for His endless favors and acknowledge that all praise belongs to Him alone.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui m\u00E9rite plus que tout autre le remerciement, la glorification et le chant d\u2019\u00E9loge

en.desc: He knows and keeps count of all things, encompassing every atom, deed, and breath within His precise knowledge, so that nothing escapes His reckoning.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Muhsi when you fear your good deeds go unseen or you long to be accountable — ask Him, who counts every deed, to record your efforts and help you guard your actions.

fr.desc: Traduit litt\u00E9ralement comme le compteur mais signifie Celui qui d\u00E9nombre chaque cr\u00E9ature, chaque acte, chaque grain de poussi\u00E8re dans son royaume et dont rien n'\u00E9chappe \u00E0 Son savoir

en.desc: He is the Originator who brings all creation into being from nothing, initiating existence without any prior model.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Mubdi when you long for a fresh start or a new beginning — ask the One who originates all things to open for you a good and blessed path ahead.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui donne un d\u00E9but \u00E0 ce qui n\u2019existe pas sans d\u00E9but, sans mod\u00E8le, c'est-\u00E0-dire Celui qui cr\u00E9e les cr\u00E9atures

en.desc: He is the One who restores and brings back what has passed, returning all creation to Him and raising the dead to life on the Day of Resurrection.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Mu'eed when you wish to recover what feels lost or broken — ask the One who restores all things to renew your strength, mend your affairs, and bring you back to Him.

fr.meaning: Celui qui fait rentrer dans le néant
fr.desc: Est Celui qui ram\u00E8ne les vivants vers la mort apr\u00E8s la vie et Celui qui ram\u00E8ne les morts \u00E0 la vie apr\u00E8s leur mort

en.desc: He is the Giver of life, who grants existence to the lifeless, revives hearts with faith, and will resurrect the dead.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Muhyi when your heart feels spiritually dead or your hope has faded — ask the Giver of Life to revive your faith and breathe new life into your circumstances.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui fait vivre un m\u00E9lange de maniyy, c'est-\u00E0-dire de liquide s\u00E9minal, d\u00E9pourvu d\u2019\u00E2me et en fait un \u00EAtre vivant et Celui qui redonne vie aux corps des humains, des djinns et des anges en les r\u00E9unissant avec leurs \u00E2mes au cours de la r\u00E9surrection

en.desc: He is the One who ordains death for every living thing at its appointed time, holding sole authority over the end of life.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Mumeet when you contemplate mortality or seek to let go of harmful habits — ask Him to grant you a good end and to cause the deadening of sin within your heart.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui fait mourir les \u00EAtres vivants et Celui qui annule par la mort le pouvoir des puissants de ce monde

en.desc: He is the Ever-Living, whose life is perfect, without beginning or end, and who never sleeps, tires, or perishes.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Hayy when you seek lasting strength and vitality of the heart — turn to the Ever-Living who never dies, for He alone remains when all else fades.

fr.desc: Le Vivant : Est Celui qui n\u2019entre pas en existence et pourtant existe, et Celui qui poss\u00E8de une hayah et cet attribut n\u2019est pas une vie comme l\u2019est la hayah des cr\u00E9atures constitu\u00E9e d\u2019une combinaison d\u2019\u00E2me, de chair et de sang l\u2019Imam At-Tahawiyy a dit dans son trait\u00E9 de croyance que \u00AB celui qui attribue \u00E0 Allah un attribut dans un sens qui compte parmi ceux que l\u2019on peut attribuer aux \u00EAtres humains est m\u00E9cr\u00E9ant \u00BB

en.desc: He is self-existing and depends on nothing, while all of creation depends entirely on Him for its existence and sustenance.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Qayyoom when you feel unable to hold your life together — lean on the One who sustains all things and let Him uphold your affairs.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui existe, est \u00E9ternel et ne change pas et Celui qui n\u2019est pas atteint par l\u2019inexistence ou l\u2019an\u00E9antissement et n\u2019est nullement affect\u00E9 par le fait de contr\u00F4ler et de cr\u00E9er les actes des \u00EAtres humains

en.desc: He is the Finder who lacks nothing and is never in need; whatever He wills, He finds and accomplishes without difficulty.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Waajid when you are searching for something you cannot find or feel a lack in your life — ask the One who finds all things to bring you what you truly need.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui n\u2019a besoin de rien et n\u2019est pas atteint ni concern\u00E9 par le besoin, le manque ou la n\u00E9cessit\u00E9

en.desc: He is glorious in His majesty and abundant in His generosity, combining nobility, honor, and boundless kindness toward His creation.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Maajid when you seek honor, dignity, or generous provision — ask the Most Glorious to grace your life with His nobility and open bounty.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui est meilleur que tout autre et Celui qui accorde d\u2019innombrables bienfaits tr\u00E8s largement et sans contrepartie

en.desc: He is the One and Unique, single in His essence and attributes, with no partner, equal, or rival in His divinity.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Waahid when you wish to purify your devotion — affirm His oneness, direct your worship to Him alone, and free your heart from attachment to any other.

fr.desc: l'Unique : Est Celui qui n\u2019a pas d\u2019alter ego, que ce soit dans Son \u00CAtre, dans Son Acte, ou dans Ses Attributs. Rien n'est tel que Lui

en.desc: He is absolutely One and indivisible, utterly unique in His oneness, such that nothing in creation resembles Him in any way.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Ahad when you seek closeness to Him in solitude — turn your whole heart to the Indivisible One, knowing He alone hears and suffices you.

fr.desc: L'Un: Est Celui Qui a pour attribut l'unicit\u00E9

en.desc: He is the Self-Sufficient Master upon whom all creation depends, the eternal One sought in every need, who needs nothing from anyone.
en.dua: Call upon As-Samad when you are in desperate need and have nowhere else to turn — direct every need to the Eternal Refuge upon whom all creation relies.

fr.desc: Est Celui \u00E0 qui l\u2019on peut se remettre pour toute affaire et \u00E0 qui l\u2019on peut faire appel pour tous nos besoins ; Celui qui n\u2019a ni enfant ni parents, ni semblable ni \u00E9quivalent, d\u2019apr\u00E8s l\u2019explication de Al-Hakim ; Celui qui n\u2019a besoin de rien et Celui dont toute chose a besoin, pour exister, etc.

en.desc: He is the All-Powerful, capable of doing whatever He wills; nothing lies beyond His power and nothing can prevent His decree.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Qaadir when a situation seems impossible — ask the All-Powerful, for whom nothing is beyond reach, to accomplish what no one else can.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui n\u2019est pas atteint par la faiblesse, Celui dont la puissance est absolue et domine la totalit\u00E9 des cr\u00E9atures et Celui qu'absolument rien ne peut affaiblir

en.desc: He holds absolute and prevailing power over all things, exercising His might with perfect mastery and control over creation.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Muqtadir when you feel overwhelmed by forces greater than yourself — place your trust in the Omnipotent, whose command overrules every power.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui est puissant sur toute chose et Celui dont les capacit\u00E9s sont absolument sans limites

en.desc: He is the One who brings forward and advances whom and what He wills, according to His perfect wisdom and justice.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Muqaddim when you seek to be brought closer to goodness — ask Him to advance you in faith and good deeds and to hasten what is best for you.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui est exempt des caract\u00E9ristiques des cr\u00E9atures et meilleur que toute cr\u00E9ature ; Celui qui fixe la vitesse des \u00E9v\u00E9nements, acc\u00E9l\u00E8re certaines choses aux yeux des gens selon une destin\u00E9e et accorde \u00E0 chaque chose une valeur, un rang, une \u00E9poque et des caract\u00E9ristiques qui Lui conviennent selon la sagesse

en.desc: He is the One who delays and postpones whom and what He wills, holding matters back in accordance with His perfect wisdom.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Mu'akhkhir when a blessing seems delayed or a hardship lingers — trust that He holds things back in wisdom, and ask Him to keep you far from what harms you.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui est exempt des caract\u00E9ristiques des cr\u00E9atures et meilleur que toute cr\u00E9ature ; Celui qui destine la lenteur des \u00E9v\u00E9nements et ralentit certaines choses aux yeux des gens selon une destin\u00E9e et accorde \u00E0 chaque chose une valeur, un rang, une \u00E9poque et des caract\u00E9ristiques qui lui conviennent selon une sagesse (cf no 71)

en.desc: He is the First, existing before all things, with no beginning to His existence and nothing preceding Him.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Awwal when you reflect on where all things begin — thank the First, who was before all else, and ask Him to guide your beginnings toward Him.

fr.desc: Le Premier : Est Celui qui existe sans les cr\u00E9atures, sans d\u00E9but et sans le temps ; Celui qui est exempt du fait d\u2019\u00EAtre cr\u00E9\u00E9, de l\u2019apparition d\u2019un nouvel attribut et du changement, Celui qui existe sans entrer en existence

en.desc: He is the Last, remaining after all creation perishes, with no end to His existence and nothing outlasting Him.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Aakhir when you fear loss or the fading of this world — take comfort that He is the Last who remains forever, and make Him your ultimate goal and return.

fr.desc: Le Dernier : Est Celui qui existe sans interruption alors que les cr\u00E9atures sont an\u00E9anties \u00E0 chaque instant ; Celui qui est \u00E9ternel, Celui qui an\u00E9antit et est exempt du fait d\u2019\u00EAtre an\u00E9anti et de la disparition d\u2019un ou plusieurs attributs ; Celui qui existe sans \u00EAtre concern\u00E9 par la notion de fin et d\u2019an\u00E9antissement

en.desc: He is the Manifest, whose existence is evident through the signs of His creation, above and beyond all things in His majesty.
en.dua: Call upon Az-Zaahir when your faith feels distant or unseen — ask the Manifest One to make the signs of His presence clear to your heart and to strengthen your certainty in Him.

fr.desc: Est Celui dont l\u2019existence se manifeste en toute chose par des preuves, du point de vue de la puissance et de la domination et non pas ce qui serait pr\u00E9sent en tout corps du point de vue de l\u2019endroit, de l\u2019image et du comment

en.desc: Allah is the Hidden One, whose essence is beyond the reach of human perception, yet whose existence is proven by everything He has created. Though He cannot be seen or grasped, He is closer to us than we can imagine.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Baatin when you feel alone or unseen in your struggles — He knows the secrets of your heart and every hidden matter, so entrust to Him what no one else can see.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui est pr\u00E9serv\u00E9 des id\u00E9es d\u00E9lirantes des cr\u00E9atures tentant d\u2019attribuer \u00E0 Celui qui cr\u00E9e les cr\u00E9atures des caract\u00E9ristiques humaines ou des caract\u00E9ristiques propres aux cr\u00E9atures et Celui qui cr\u00E9e les caract\u00E9ristiques des cr\u00E9atures et leurs images

en.desc: Allah is the sole Governor and Protector who owns all things and manages the affairs of the entire creation. Nothing in the universe operates outside of His authority and care.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Waali when your affairs feel out of your control — place your matters in the hands of the One who governs all things with perfect wisdom and power.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui poss\u00E8de, g\u00E8re et contr\u00F4le toute chose et Celui qui cr\u00E9e toute chose selon une sagesse

en.desc: Allah is the Most Exalted, transcendent above all of His creation and far removed from any limitation or imperfection. His greatness is higher than anything the mind can conceive.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Muta'ali when you seek to glorify Allah and rise above worldly worries — remembering His supreme majesty puts every hardship into its proper perspective.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui est exempt des attributs des cr\u00E9atures et Celui dont le pouvoir sur les cr\u00E9atures est sans borne

en.desc: Allah is the Source of All Goodness, boundlessly kind and gentle to His creation. He is the origin of every blessing, treating His servants with generosity even when they fall short.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Barr when you long for goodness and kindness in your life — He is the fountain of all good, ever gentle toward those who turn to Him.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui a la capacit\u00E9 de destiner la foi et les bienfaits \u00E0 toutes les cr\u00E9atures, et parmi elles certaines sont reconnaissantes et certaines ne le sont pas : on appelle les premiers des musulmans ou des croyants et les autres les non-musulmans ou les non-croyants

en.desc: Allah is the One who continually accepts the repentance of His servants and guides them to turn back to Him. He welcomes the returning heart with mercy, no matter how many times it strays.
en.dua: Call upon At-Tawwaab when you have sinned and wish to return to Allah — He accepts sincere repentance again and again, no matter how often you turn back to Him.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui accorde le pardon \u00E0 ceux qui se repentent \u00E0 chaque fois qu\u2019ils se repentent

en.desc: Allah is the Avenger, who justly holds the arrogant and the oppressors to account for their wrongdoing. His retribution is never unjust, but a perfect expression of His justice.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Muntaqim when you have been wronged and see no earthly justice — entrust your grievance to the One who will set right every injustice in His perfect time.

fr.desc: Est le vengeur

en.desc: Allah is the Pardoner, who not only forgives sins but erases them completely, leaving no trace behind. His pardon is even greater than forgiveness, for He wipes the record clean.
en.dua: Call upon Al-'Afuww when you carry the weight of past mistakes — ask Him to pardon and erase your sins entirely, as taught in the dua: 'O Allah, You are the Pardoner who loves to pardon, so pardon me.'

fr.desc: Est Celui qui \u00E9carte du p\u00E9ch\u00E9 et le pardonne et Celui qui pr\u00E9serve dans chaque situation en apparence sans issue une porte vers l\u2019honneur, le maintien et les bienfaits ou vers le repentir imm\u00E9diat

en.desc: Allah is the Most Kind and Compassionate, whose gentleness and tenderness toward His creation know no bounds. His compassion shields His servants and eases their burdens.
en.dua: Call upon Ar-Ra'oof when you are in pain or distress and need gentle comfort — His tender kindness surrounds those who seek His mercy.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui peut offrir une immensit\u00E9 de bienfaits sans contrepartie et sans n\u00E9cessit\u00E9

en.desc: Allah is the Owner of All Sovereignty, who grants dominion to whom He wills and withdraws it from whom He wills. All power and kingship in existence belong to Him alone.
en.dua: Call upon Maalik-ul-Mulk when you seek honor, authority, or provision — recognize that all power belongs to Him, and ask Him to grant you good from His limitless dominion.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui cr\u00E9e et attribue selon une destin\u00E9e toute souverainet\u00E9, domination, propri\u00E9t\u00E9 et tout large pouvoir qui sont accord\u00E9s \u00E0 certaines cr\u00E9atures dans ce bas monde

en.meaning: The Lord of Majesty and Honor
en.desc: Allah is the Lord of Majesty and Honor, possessing both awe-inspiring greatness and boundless generosity. He alone is worthy of ultimate reverence and the source of all honor.
en.dua: Call upon Dhul-Jalaali wal-Ikraam in your most earnest supplications — the Prophet (peace be upon him) taught us to persist in invoking this name when asking Allah for our needs.

fr.meaning: Le Plein de Majesté et de Magnificience
fr.desc: C\u2019est-\u00E0-dire qu'Allah est Celui qui est meilleur que tout autre en r\u00E9alit\u00E9 et toutes les preuves confirment cela et infirment le contraire donc il n\u2019est pas valable de contester ce point, de le renier ou d\u2019\u00EAtre hostile \u00E0 l\u2019encontre de ce sujet ; est Celui qui comble de bienfaits ceux qui auront compris cela qui conna\u00EEtront la saintet\u00E9 g\u00E9n\u00E9rale, auront la r\u00E9ussite et seront bien guid\u00E9s au Jour du Jugement

en.desc: Allah is the Equitable One, who acts with perfect fairness and establishes justice among all of His creation. He gives every soul exactly what it is due, wronging no one.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Muqsit when you seek fairness in a dispute or long to be treated justly — He is the perfectly just One who balances every scale with equity.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui juge conform\u00E9ment \u00E0 la plus grande justice, Celui qui est exempt de toute forme d\u2019injustice et de tyrannie et Celui qui n\u2019a absolument aucun compte \u00E0 rendre

en.desc: Allah is the Gatherer, who brings together all of creation and will assemble every soul on the Day of Judgment. He unites what is scattered by His will and wisdom.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Jaami' when you are separated from loved ones or long for reconciliation — He gathers hearts and reunites what has been parted.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui rassemble les cr\u00E9atures en un jour au sujet duquel il n\u2019y a pas de doute, le Jour du Jugement

en.desc: Allah is the Self-Sufficient One, utterly free of any need, while all of creation depends entirely upon Him. He possesses complete richness in Himself and needs nothing from anyone.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Ghaniyy when you feel poor, needy, or dependent — turn to the One who is free of all need and can enrich you from His limitless treasures.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui n\u2019a aucun besoin des cr\u00E9atures et dont les cr\u00E9atures ne peuvent se passer de al-Ghaniyy [qui est Celui qui les fait exister et les maintient en existence et les fait changer en permanence]

en.desc: Allah is the Enricher, who bestows wealth, contentment, and sufficiency upon whomever He wills. True richness of the heart and of provision comes from Him alone.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Mughni when you are in financial hardship or seek contentment — ask the One who enriches His servants to grant you sufficiency and peace of heart.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui satisfait les besoins des cr\u00E9atures et Celui qui leur fait parvenir leur subsistance

en.desc: Allah is the Withholder, who in His wisdom prevents and holds back whatever He wills. What He withholds, no one can grant, and often His withholding is itself a hidden mercy.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Maani' when you need protection from harm or seek to be shielded from what could hurt you — He can hold back every trouble by His will.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui destine \u00E0 chaque cr\u00E9ature ses victoires, ses protections et Celui dont ils devront \u00EAtre pr\u00E9serv\u00E9s toujours selon une destin\u00E9e

en.desc: Allah is the One who allows harm and adversity to occur by His wisdom, for nothing can afflict a servant except by His permission. Every trial He permits carries a purpose known to Him alone.
en.dua: Call upon Ad-Daarr when you fear harm or face adversity — seek refuge in Him alone, for the One who permits hardship is also the only One able to remove it.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui est tout puissant \u00E0 faire parvenir immanquablement la nuisance qui doit atteindre une cr\u00E9ature selon une destin\u00E9e

en.desc: Allah is the source of all benefit and good, for no advantage or blessing reaches a servant except by His will. He bestows benefit upon whom He wills, whenever He wills.
en.dua: Call upon An-Naafi' when you seek benefit, healing, or success in any endeavor — all good comes from Him, so ask Him to make your efforts fruitful.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui est tout puissant \u00E0 faire parvenir immanquablement le profit que doit recevoir une cr\u00E9ature selon une destin\u00E9e

en.desc: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth, who illuminates creation and guides hearts out of darkness. His light is both physical and spiritual, dispelling every kind of gloom.
en.dua: Call upon An-Noor when you feel lost in confusion or spiritual darkness — ask Him to fill your heart, sight, and path with His guiding light.

fr.desc: La Lumi\u00E8re : Est Celui qui guide vers leur but ceux qui sont en proie \u00E0 la tentation et les met dans la bonne direction selon une destin\u00E9e ; Allah est Celui qui guide les croyants vers la lumi\u00E8re de la foi, cr\u00E9e la lumi\u00E8re et n\u2019est pas une lumi\u00E8re qui n\u2019est qu\u2019une cr\u00E9ature

en.desc: Allah is the Guide, who leads His servants to the truth and to the straight path. Every heart that finds guidance does so only because He has guided it.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Haadi when you face a difficult decision or seek the right path — ask the One who guides hearts to lead you to what is true and good.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui destine \u00E0 certaines cr\u00E9atures le b\u00E9n\u00E9fice d'\u00EAtre bien guid\u00E9 et de conna\u00EEtre la droiture

en.desc: Allah is the Originator, who creates everything in existence without any prior model or precedent. His creation is wholly unique, unmatched, and beyond imitation.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Badee' when you long for a fresh start or a way out of a situation with no apparent solution — the Originator can create ease and openings from nothing.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui fait exister les cr\u00E9atures et ce monde, non pas \u00E0 partir d\u2019une mati\u00E8re pr\u00E9existante ou \u00E0 l\u2019image d\u2019un mod\u00E8le ant\u00E9rieur, mais au contraire sans pr\u00E9curseur, sans mod\u00E8le et sans pr\u00E9c\u00E9dent

en.desc: Allah is the Everlasting One, who remains eternally after all creation has perished. He alone endures without beginning or end, unaffected by time or change.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Baaqi when worldly things fade or you grieve what is passing — anchor your heart to the One who remains forever when all else comes to an end.

fr.desc: Est Celui dont l\u2019existence exempte d\u2019an\u00E9antissement et de changement s\u2019impose \u00E0 la raison saine qui ne peut pr\u00E9tendre le contraire

en.desc: Allah is the Inheritor, to whom all things return after their owners have passed away. He is the ultimate and lasting owner of everything in the heavens and the earth.
en.dua: Call upon Al-Waarith when you worry about the future or what will remain after you — everything ultimately returns to Him, so entrust your legacy and loved ones to His care.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui existe et ne change pas alors que les cr\u00E9atures sont an\u00E9anties

en.meaning: The Guide to the Right Path
en.desc: Allah is the Guide to the Right Path, whose every decree is directed with perfect wisdom toward its rightful purpose. He guides all affairs to their most sound and proper end.
en.dua: Call upon Ar-Rasheed when you need wise direction or sound judgment in your affairs — ask the One who orders all things rightly to steer you toward the wisest course.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui guide les cr\u00E9atures vers ce qui est dans leur int\u00E9r\u00EAt

en.desc: Allah is the Patient One, who does not hasten punishment and gives His servants ample time to turn back to Him. His forbearance is limitless, born of His wisdom and mercy.
en.dua: Call upon As-Saboor when you are tested and struggle to endure — ask the Most Patient to grant you steadfastness and calm in the face of hardship.

fr.desc: Est Celui qui retarde la punition des p\u00E9cheurs par l\u2019ajustement des comptes de chacun jusqu\u2019\u00E0 un jour bien d\u00E9termin\u00E9 et leur accorde leur aise et du temps jusqu\u2019\u00E0 un moment dont ils ignorent tous la date.
